name: harness-prompt-cache-stability
title: Harness prompt-prefix cache stability
description: Stabilize the model-visible request prefix across adjacent Runs without weakening per-Run extension authority, then prove materially higher DeepSeek cache reuse with deterministic request-shape tests and a real upstream probe.
